title: Enrique Jimenez (RC) BCP-31 Topps Bowman Chrome Detroit Tigers 2024 Base Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024 Bowman Chrome baseball trading card featuring Enrique Jimenez of the Detroit Tigers. The card is from the rookie set BCP-31 and is in the popular Chrome parallel/variety. Manufactured by Topps, this card is a part of the Major League (MLB) league and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. The card is in excellent condition and is a must-have for any baseball collector or Detroit Tigers fan.
